question: Which actual sampled collector fields support the 19 raw/served disagreements, and what receipt bounds can be recovered without asserting unrecorded server timing?
cohort: Exactly all 38 outgoing cycle6 decisions / 19 unique bus-polls / 9 source visits; both destinations retained. Windows from pin-60s to departure+90s for each visit. No selection by prediction error.
rules: Only whitelist raw transit fields, sample clock and feedAgeMs; no DOM text or private data exported.
For observed_at, exact equality to archived raw frame gives exact collection identity; require same bus_id/route/lat/lon/heading.
Without observed_at, retain ALL raw frames matching bus id/route/GPS/heading and published last_moved_at within [feed receipt - 120s, feed receipt]; no nearest-time arbitrary matching.

feedAt = sampleAt-feedAgeMs is watcher response-handler clock, not source collection nor first-publication time. Field onset bracket from successive captured responses, with skipped polls and censoring explicit.
No served ETA rows are stored by the watcher; cannot assert historical live server disagreement from raw evidence alone.
No new fit, thresholds, ETA arms, source edit or production claim. Stop after bounded provenance audit; leave missing captures and ambiguous matches visible.
